subject: soc-rt-dy
title: SOC.RT.DY.------PHY.U.P.
description: Chart on book p. 47 (SD(SY)-25). SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) is the partner. From the subject: POL-P (political policies). From POL-P: CN-INFO (controlled information). From CN-INFO: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and TM (terminology—or terms of a definition), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From TM: INT (intention), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From INT: CUL-INFO-B. From CUL-INFO-B: TRS (transition).
